import sys

def solve():
    input = sys.stdin.read
    data = input().split()
    iterator = iter(data)
    
    N = int(next(iterator))
    K = int(next(iterator))
    
    victims = set(range(1, N + 1))
    
    for _ in range(K):
        d = int(next(iterator))
        for _ in range(d):
            snuke_id = int(next(iterator))
            victims.remove(snuke_id)
    
    print(len(victims))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()
